description: Selected MRI sequences show a well-defined round mass centered within the trigone of the left lateral ventricle.  The mass is isointense to gray matter on T1 and T2-weighted images, and exhibits homogeneous enhancement.  Perilesional white matter edema and obstructive hydrocephalus are seen.
